name: Page
summary: A manual page: paper sheet, margins, running header and “Página N” footer.

name: TitlePage
summary: The manual's cover, one A4 page: title block at the top, ribbon, credits and details at the foot. Four variants (mosaic by default, band, motif, editorial); “[…]” lines show as placeholders.
props: Cover design. Default 'mosaic': the nine box colours as a strip of plain squares.
In print, colour runs to the paper edge.
Volume or unit number, shown large by 'editorial'.
Text between the two navy rules.
Authors and institution; the first line is bold. “[…]” marks a placeholder.

name: TableOfContents
summary: “Índice”: levels 1–3 with dotted leaders to the page number.

name: ChapterOpener
summary: Unit opener: “Unidad N” kicker, unit title (h1) and a lead paragraph.

name: BoxLegend
summary: “Cómo usar este manual”: the legend of box types, grouped by family.

name: Heading
summary: Headings: 1 for unnumbered unit-level sections (Glosario, Referencias), 2 sections, 3 sub-sections.

name: Paragraph
summary: Body paragraph: 16px Cambria, 1.6 leading; left-aligned on screen, justified in print.

name: BulletList
summary: Bullet list (● ○ ■ by level). An item is a string or { text, items } for a nested level.

name: Bibliography
summary: Declares the works a unit can cite; <Cite id> and <ReferencesBox auto> read from it, so citations and references can’t disagree.
props: Structured works: { id, type: 'book'|'article'|'chapter'|'web', authors: [{ family, given, suffix? } | { literal }], year, title, … }.

name: Cite
summary: APA 7 in-text citation with page: (Biggs & Tang, 2011, p. 45) or Biggs y Tang (2011, p. 45). Inside <Bibliography>, cite by id.
props: Work id declared in <Bibliography>; replaces authors and year and registers the work as cited.
Surnames in source order; 3+ become “et al.”.
Several works in one parenthesis, alphabetical.

name: Quote
summary: Short quotation (under 40 words) in English double quotes “…”, followed by its APA citation.

name: BlockQuote
summary: APA 7 block quotation (40 words or more): indented, no quotation marks, citation after the final period.
props: Quoted passage ending with its period.

name: KeyPoints
summary: “Puntos Clave”: the unit summary, first box of every unit (3–5 one-line items), with optional “Antes de leer” questions.
props: 1–3 “Antes de leer” questions, revisited in “Para Seguir Pensando”.

name: Objectives
summary: “Objetivos”: numbered learning objectives (O1, O2…), each written for one Bloom (revised) level; the level is kept as data, not shown.
props: Objectives starting with a verb of their level; ids default to O1, O2…

name: Important
summary: “Importante”: a key concept or definition the reader should retain.

name: CommonMistake
summary: “Error Frecuente”: a refutation in three moves — misconception, cited correction, and why the belief does not hold.
props: Why the belief is wrong or why it is attractive (“Por qué no se sostiene”).

name: Classroom
summary: “En el Aula”: a worked classroom case — situation, didactic decision and its rationale.

name: ThinkFurther
summary: “Para Seguir Pensando”: open questions with no single answer; not assessed.
props: The “Antes de leer” questions from KeyPoints, brought back at the close.

name: SelfCheck
summary: “Autoevaluación”: retrieval practice with feedback; answers open on screen and print as a key.
props: 3–5 short recall questions; review names an earlier unit.

name: Activities
summary: “Actividades”: assessable questions and tasks, tagged with their type and the objectives they practise; the Bloom level is kept as data, not shown.
props: (string | { type?; level?: BloomId; objectives?: string[]; text })[]
Numbered activities; objectives link to O1, O2…

name: ReferencesBox
summary: “Referencias”: the unit’s APA 7 list, French indent — hand-written <Reference> items, or `auto`: the works cited in the unit, formatted and ordered.
props: Inside <Bibliography>: list the works cited above, in APA order.
List every declared work (a manual-wide bibliography).

name: AlignmentTable
summary: Alignment table: which activities practise each objective, flagging gaps and level mismatches.
props: The same array passed to Objectives.
The same array passed to Activities.

name: Box
summary: The shared frame of the didactic boxes; its family sets the shape (open: filled header, text: top rule, close: plain frame).

name: Icon
summary: A Lucide line icon drawn in currentColor. Decorative unless given a label.
props: One of the seven box icons.

name: DataTable
summary: APA 7 table: “Tabla N” and italic title above, horizontal rules, light header (or `filled`), optional row headers, “Nota.” below.
props: Registry id inside <Numbering> (automatic number, cross-reference target).
First column as row headers (conceptual tables).

name: Figure
summary: APA 7 figure: “Figura N” and the italic title above a diagram or image; “Nota.” below. Numbered automatically by id inside <Numbering>.
props: Registry id inside <Numbering>: the number comes from it and <FigRef> can point to it.

name: Numbering
summary: Numbers figures and tables from their ids, in order of first mention, so cross-references never break.
props: Figure ids in order of first mention.
Table ids in order of first mention.
Start of the figure count (continue from an earlier unit).

name: FigRef
summary: Cross-reference to a figure or table by id: “Figura 2”, or with paren “(véase la Figura 2)”.

name: ConceptWeb
summary: Concept web: a central concept linked to up to 8 related concepts, with relation labels and short details. Below 600px of width it keeps its size and scrolls sideways; “Ver como texto” shows the same structure as a list.
props: Related concepts, clockwise from the top.

name: CycleDiagram
summary: Cycle: 3–8 steps around a circle joined by arrows, with an optional centre label. Below 600px of width it keeps its size and scrolls sideways; “Ver como texto” shows the same structure as a list.

name: Pyramid
summary: Pyramid of levels, top (most advanced) first, e.g. Miller's pyramid; descriptions to the right. Below 600px of width it keeps its size and scrolls sideways; “Ver como texto” shows the same structure as a list.

name: ProcessFlow
summary: Process flow: numbered steps joined by arrows; horizontal on wide screens, vertical on narrow ones.

name: TreeDiagram
summary: Hierarchy or classification: a root and up to three levels below. Top-down with up to 4 leaves, left to right with more. Below 600px of width it keeps its size and scrolls sideways; “Ver como texto” shows the same structure as a list.
props: The root node; children nest the same shape.
Layout; 'auto' goes right when leaves would not fit across.

name: ConceptMap
summary: Concept map (Novak): concepts in levels joined by labelled arrows, so each link reads as a proposition. Below 600px of width it keeps its size and scrolls sideways; “Ver como texto” shows the same structure as a list.
props: Concepts; level 0 is the most general, at the top.

name: MindMap
summary: Mind map: a central topic with branches to both sides and short ideas hanging from each. Below 600px of width it keeps its size and scrolls sideways; “Ver como texto” shows the same structure as a list.
props: Branches (up to 6), each with up to 3 short ideas.

name: VennDiagram
summary: Venn diagram: what two or three concepts share and what is exclusive to each. Below 600px of width it keeps its size and scrolls sideways; “Ver como texto” shows the same structure as a list.
props: { a?; b?; c?; ab?; ac?; bc?; abc?: string[] }

name: QuadrantMatrix
summary: 2 × 2 matrix: two axes (low → high) and four quadrants; the high–high quadrant is emphasised. Below 600px of width it keeps its size and scrolls sideways; “Ver como texto” shows the same structure as a list.

name: Timeline
summary: Timeline: dated events along an axis, labels alternating above and below (up to 8). Below 600px of width it keeps its size and scrolls sideways; “Ver como texto” shows the same structure as a list.

name: Fishbone
summary: Cause-and-effect (Ishikawa) diagram: categories of causes along a spine that leads to an effect. Below 600px of width it keeps its size and scrolls sideways; “Ver como texto” shows the same structure as a list.
props: Up to 6 categories with up to 3 causes each.

name: Spectrum
summary: Continuum between two poles, with items placed by position (0 = left pole, 1 = right pole). Below 600px of width it keeps its size and scrolls sideways; “Ver como texto” shows the same structure as a list.

name: Funnel
summary: Funnel: stages that narrow from the general to the specific (curriculum levels, selection processes). Below 600px of width it keeps its size and scrolls sideways; “Ver como texto” shows the same structure as a list.

name: Staircase
summary: Staircase: progressive levels that build on one another, lowest at the left (Bloom, rubric levels). Below 600px of width it keeps its size and scrolls sideways; “Ver como texto” shows the same structure as a list.

name: NestedCircles
summary: Nested circles: contexts or categories that contain one another, with a legend. Below 600px of width it keeps its size and scrolls sideways; “Ver como texto” shows the same structure as a list.

name: Iceberg
summary: Iceberg: what is visible above the waterline and what lies beneath it (explicit and hidden curriculum). Below 600px of width it keeps its size and scrolls sideways; “Ver como texto” shows the same structure as a list.

name: GlossaryEntry
summary: Glossary entry: the term in bold navy, a colon, then the definition.

name: Reference
summary: One APA 7 reference with a French (hanging) indent; pass the title in <i>.

name: Term
summary: A term in running text linked to its glossary entry (dotted azure underline).
props: The term as it appears in the sentence.

name: Glossary
summary: Glossary built from entries, sorted alphabetically (Spanish collation); each entry is a link target for <Term>.
